# Demo fixtures

## `server-ffa3-phase0.dm_26`

A capture of the real `linuxjampded` 1.011 server message stream, in the demo
framing (`int32 sequence, int32 length, payload*`, `-1/-1` terminator), used as
the Phase 0 golden gamestate and as a parser fixture.

- Source: pristine `original/jalinuxded_1.011/linuxjampded` run in the
  `jampgame-investigation:i386-bookworm` container, `g_gametype 0`,
  `+map mp/ffa3`.
- Capture tool: `tools/runtime/demo_capture.py` (synthetic protocol-26 client;
  the payloads are the server's own bytes after `CL_Netchan_Process`, i.e. what
  `CL_WriteDemoMessage` would store).
- Command (server on UDP 29120):

  ```sh
  docker run -d --name jka-demo0 -p 29120:29120/udp \
    -v "$PWD/original/GameData":/srv/jka/gamedata:ro \
    jampgame-investigation:i386-bookworm \
    ./linuxjampded +set dedicated 1 +set net_port 29120 \
      +set fs_cdpath /srv/jka/gamedata +set sv_pure 0 \
      +set sv_maxclients 8 +set g_gametype 0 \
      +set timelimit 0 +set fraglimit 0 +map mp/ffa3

  python3 tools/runtime/demo_capture.py 127.0.0.1 29120 \
    --out tests/fixtures/demo/server-ffa3-phase0.dm_26 --duration 4
  ```

- SHA-256:
  `d59520264fe5e2f75554c4a0b4bead9d574a6bd8774ac5c721d664206f274ce0`.

Properties (checked with `tools/demo_inspect.py`):

- 79 frames, `-1/-1` terminator, no trailing bytes.
- Frame 0: real server gamestate, 62 configstrings, 49 baselines,
  `clientNum 0`, `checksumFeed 0xd8e9a7d8`, RMG short `0`, tail `svc_EOF (10)`.
- Frames 1..: `svc_setgame` and snapshots for a client that never sent a
  usercmd (a `CS_PRIMED` connection). This is a message-stream fixture, not a
  complete playable demo.

## `server-ffa3-phase0.gamestate.bin`

The decoded first frame, generated by the Phase 0 decoder for the Rust
byte-exact encoder test (`rust/src/demo/gamestate.rs`):

```sh
python3 tools/demo_inspect.py tests/fixtures/demo/server-ffa3-phase0.dm_26 \
  --frames 1 --dump-gamestate-sidecar \
  tests/fixtures/demo/server-ffa3-phase0.gamestate.bin
```

- SHA-256:
  `3e6c40d320abffc5d0becf18fe8cf2cad6ea8c1e1cf40de917bfc873c486e428`.
- Layout: 8-byte `DMGS1\0\0\0` magic, the four header ints, the RMG short,
  `u32 meaningful_bits` (the Phase 0 `end_bit`, including the trailing
  `svc_EOF`), configstrings, then 49
  little-endian 532-byte `entityState_t` baseline images.
- The Rust test reads this sidecar and the original `.dm_26` first frame, then
  re-encodes with the pure-Rust encoder and compares the meaningful bytes
  (bits `[0, meaningful_bits)`; the trailing padding byte convention is in
  `docs/demo-format.md` §3). The sidecar exists because the Rust dev container
  has no Python and Phase 1 must not grow a second demo parser.
